svg.title: Their weighted footprint sums have respectively budgets βu F and βb F . These are the sales inequalities used in the connected expansion: the weights include the specified footprint exponential, overlap price, radius charge and retained derivatives. All the ancillary costs enter before the budget is reduced to the displayed powers. To see the exponent bookkeeping, the local estimates give a base envelope b(0) p , obtained by combining the inherited physical letters, the finite local logarithmic letters and the covariance- window letters.
